assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are repository provisional constraints, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All locations, areas, figures and ratios must be recomputed when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Statutory controls, ownership, road redlines, heritage controls, municipal capacity and engineering conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No FAR, height, demolition, road-redline or construction conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: No cleared parcel-level baseline exists for night noise, lighting, sleep disturbance, ecology or pedestrian comfort.
assumptions.impact: Night rules are performance questions and trial gates, not claimed compliance values.

assumptions.statement: No operator, service schedule or AI scenario is authorised.
assumptions.impact: Every timetable and protocol is a reference scheme requiring public and professional review.

assumptions.statement: Night-shift staffing, pay, break, safety and transport arrangements are not confirmed.
assumptions.impact: Night work cannot start until worker representatives and responsible operators approve the plan.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection extents and cleared historic media are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Railway narratives use original abstract graphics; physical work awaits heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Global cases are used to compare mechanisms, not to import planning parameters or claim equivalence.
assumptions.impact: Local baselines and approvals govern every Beijing application.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are small reversible placeholders for design review, not surveyed existing buildings or approved construction.
assumptions.impact: Professional teams must survey, test alternatives and confirm retain-renovate-demolish decisions.
